prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production sprite sheet for the mobile pixel-art refinery tycoon Refinery Story. Create TWELVE separate small player-placeable garden and industrial-yard decorations, arranged exactly as 4 rows and 3 columns on transparent background. Clear wide transparent gutters, centered complete subject within each cell, no overlap or clipping. All decorations fit an identical square ONE TILE footprint. Orthographic top-down three-quarter view: flat screen-aligned roofs, visible south face only, zero isometric diamond perspective. Crisp authentic hand-placed chunky pixel art, dark 1-pixel outlines at the logical sprite scale, bright cheerful colours, restrained 3-tone shading, light upper left. Target detail density like a 64px wide game sprite: NOT smooth painting or vector art. No ground slab or baked grass patch; no text, letters, numbers or labels.
Row 1 left to right: a compact palm tree; a dense clipped round flowering shrub with pink blossoms; a rectangular low green hedge.
Row 2: a wooden park bench facing south; a round low blue fountain with a tiny central water jet; a small red-roof wooden garden pavilion on four posts.
Row 3: a little circular flower planter with mixed red yellow white flowers; a compact picnic table with two attached benches; a blue-and-cream drink vending machine.
Row 4: a safety equipment cabinet with red fire extinguisher; a pair of blue and green recycling bins; a short decorative cream concrete fence with two square posts and dark metal rail.
Every object distinct, practical tiny park/building-yard ornament, consistently scaled for the same one-tile square. Tall trees extend upward with no extra footprint. Transparent background, no extra objects.
